data.summary: The batch2 directory contains CSV datasets representing core e-commerce entities including customers, orders, order items, and products. These data files form the relational foundation for transactional processing and business analytics.

file_insights.name: customers.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores customer profile information and membership tiers.
file_insights.source_summary: CSV file containing columns customer_id, name, city, membership_tier, and updated_at with sample customer entries.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains customer master data including IDs, names, cities, and membership tiers. Represents the primary customer entity in the e-commerce data layer.
responsibilities: Maintains customer profile and location information

file_insights.name: order_items.csv
file_insights.summary: Contains order item details including quantities and unit prices.
file_insights.source_summary: CSV file with columns order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, and updated_at storing transaction line item records.
file_insights.detailed_description: Stores line items for individual orders, capturing quantities, unit prices, and product associations. Acts as an associative relationship dataset between orders and products.
responsibilities: Tracks quantity and pricing details per item

file_insights.name: orders.csv
file_insights.summary: Maintains order tracking information and status updates.
file_insights.source_summary: CSV file with columns order_id, customer_id, order_status, ordered_at, and updated_at representing order transactions.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains transactional order headers including status, customer association, and timestamps. Essential for order lifecycle management and reporting.

file_insights.name: products.csv
file_insights.summary: Contains product catalog data, categories, and prices.
file_insights.source_summary: CSV file containing product_id, name, category, price, and updated_at fields for available products.
file_insights.detailed_description: Stores catalog information for products including categories and pricing. Acts as the product catalog data source.
